detail: Six beats of first clearance: 1. Entry — the manifest is laid on the counter, read before the crate is looked at. 2. The beam — weighed against the counter's copy of the standard, nested bell weights from 1588. 3. Stricken — the searcher strikes level across the open crate. 4. The band — the customer chooses a rate band, not a number; bands are hypotheses. 5. The seal and the niche — the stamp goes on the crate's flank; the box's original is in a niche at the temple with no door. 6. Forfeit, quietly — a second consignment fails the strike, walks one corridor to the yard, becomes stock under find.py flags.
note: Six beats of the first clearance. The customs punishes; the store absorbs; the two rooms, one trade.
